task: Core #1186 F6-U03o: isolated PG17 anonymous Office RLS and foreign-tenant SECURITY DEFINER helper denial proof

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Critical local row-permission diagnostic only; reuse original source and two-tenant authenticated RLS fixtures. No hosted JWT/SQL, no real provider access, no source modifications, release always false.

acceptanceCriteria: Exact source-authentic 78-file original local SQL bootstraps in identity-verified disposable PG17 with original preflight/postflight/COMMIT.
Original F6-U03n schema, role-smoke and two-tenant fixture plus original 3-case positive/negative RLS harness PASS in the same database before new checks.
Anonymous role has current_user='anon', no BYPASSRLS, auth.uid() IS NULL and office_threads/messages/tasks all return zero with unfiltered queries.
Authenticated helper calls use per-case BEGIN, SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated, SET LOCAL request.jwt.claim.sub and ROLLBACK; current_user and rolbypassrls captured.

Exact native source-role expected helper results: private.current_user_can_read_office_thread_v1 checks participation/current actor and MUST deny foreign A->B/B->A/nonmember, but it is not the plan gate for Alap internal; private.office_thread_plan_allowed_v2 and private.office_task_plan_allowed_v2 require A customer TRUE, B customer and B internal TRUE, A internal FALSE even with manual teamChat, and foreign/unknown FALSE.
Missing source functions, role grants or one legitimate positive fails closed; any cross-store TRUE, anonymous row, local superuser probe or absent foreign negative fails.
JSON report always syntheticJwt=true, realSignedJwtProven=false, providerManagedProven=false, releaseAuthorized=false, hostedTouched=false; success means only local row/helper behavior.

Canonical Development Guard, Plan Before Code, Edit-Time, Incremental Replay, exact-head quality/typecheck/build/security/Truth/Lifecycle and dedicated Docker role tests PASS before marking unit closed.
invariants: Original F6-U03k 78 source SQL and F6-U03n seed/role code remain immutable; new test is additive only.
No changes to baseline migrations, RLS policies, role grants or public RPC signatures.
No role probe runs under table owner, service_role or BYPASSRLS principal.
No data leaked through indirect helper calls with foreign instance/thread id.
No local synthetic role success is called real Supabase Auth JWT or hosted release proof.
forbiddenStates: Anonymous source Office relation SELECT reveals any A/B row or anonymous auth.uid non-null.
Any owner helper returns true for foreign webshop thread or missing participant while marked pass.
Positive control absent but negatives all false and marked verified.
RLS source altered to make row tests pass, or test runs service_role/superuser and calls it authenticated.
An actual hosted Supabase project accessed, reset, staging unpaused or an approved release is inferred.

failureModes: Anonymous role inherits SELECT from PUBLIC and RLS policy includes broad anon visibility unexpectedly.
Foreign instance_id and target thread_id are mismatched but SECURITY DEFINER returns TRUE through global organization role.
Helper tests call old/overloaded signature rather than source-defined UUID UUID.
Testing only false cases misses broken positive legitimate Alap customer service.
Unscoped postgres connection sees seeded rows and is incorrectly counted as browser role.
Request-local auth.uid claim bleeds across ROLLBACK transactions.
An absent function errors mid-SQL but shell ignores because psql ON_ERROR_STOP missing.
edgeCases: Role anon may get SQL permission denied rather than a zero-row result: must distinguish expected deny from unexpected data leak, and positive permission must not be granted just for a test.
PostgreSQL `auth.uid()` function has a local synthetic override in F6-U03n; ensure new role checks explicitly record the shim evidence and no signed token.
Source helper `office_thread_plan_allowed_v2` ultimately calls `public.can_read_office_thread_v1` under SECURITY DEFINER and must observe current auth.uid claim.
Alap internal_private denial despite a manual teamChat grant; Pro internal positive requires participant link.
Anonymous service_role-only inbound v3 is out of scope and remains covered by F6-U03l.
Do not infer REST API exposure from PostgreSQL schema USAGE.

Anon direct SELECT may be rejected by relation/scheme ACL (SQLSTATE 42501) instead of returning zero rows. Execute actual SELECT under anon in a PLpgSQL exception-protected DO and capture deny vs zero; any visible row fails, unexpected SQLSTATE fails.

specialistReviews.resolution: Role/claim/session execution provenance and mandatory synthetic-only release blocked flags; real hosted JWT explicitly unresolved.

specialistReviews.resolution: Reuse independently verified F6-U03n exact source fixture and do not rewrite SQL; all positive controls required.

challenge.scenario: Anon opens every Office relation in the real original PG17 schema but one permissive policy allows data without auth.uid, and the matrix falsely passes because it looks only at a filtered `WHERE instance_id = NULL` query.
challenge.finding: Filtered empty rows do not prove anonymous isolation and can hide a policy leak.
challenge.resolution: Use unfiltered COUNT(*) over all three real Office tables under current_user anon/rolbypassrls=false and auth.uid NULL; any visible row must fail.

challenge.scenario: A registered owner in tenant A invokes SECURITY DEFINER `private.office_thread_plan_allowed_v2` passing tenant B instance and B thread and the helper returns TRUE due to an actor independent shortcut.
challenge.finding: Cross-tenant disclosure through direct helper despite a safe visible page list.
challenge.resolution: Under A authenticated role and A current uid, directly call the exact two-UUID source helper for B instance+B thread and assert false; repeat B->A, and unknown user->both.

challenge.scenario: All private helper invocations return FALSE because auth.uid local shim did not get set, and the test reports cross-tenant denial PASS.
challenge.resolution: For each real owner require a same-tenant customer positive, plus B internal participant positive, asserting role and uid; any missing true aborts.

challenge.scenario: Test runs SET ROLE service_role or postgres for helper results and sees TRUE from bypass privileges.
challenge.finding: This is not browser role authorization.
challenge.resolution: Test transactions use SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated with current_user and pg_roles.rolbypassrls captured and fail on mismatch.

challenge.scenario: Caller uses instance A and thread B across IDs but only tests a missing nonexistent thread that always returns false.
challenge.finding: Bad matrix may never exercise legitimate foreign populated row.
challenge.resolution: Use explicitly seeded B foreign thread ID and verify actual two-tenant fixture's positive row proof first, then test cross-pair.

challenge.scenario: Alap customer owner has stale manual teamChat entitlement but direct thread helper returns true for internal_private despite outer RLS blocking it.
challenge.finding: The participation helper may report the Alap owner as an internal-thread participant, but the separate restrictive plan-scoped helpers must still deny the Pro-only internal chat; conflating the two helper layers creates false positive risk assertions.
challenge.resolution: Assert participation helper is FALSE for foreign/unknown (and TRUE for allowed customer), while only plan-scoped thread/task helper is required FALSE for A internal and TRUE for A customer/B private. Keep full original relation RLS as separately proven.

challenge.scenario: A test function call fails with permission denied or missing signature yet the psql shell swallows it and report claims denied because no true output.
challenge.finding: An execution failure is not equivalent to evaluated FALSE.
challenge.resolution: Use psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1; parse exact JSON case count and require boolean values, fail any missing or malformed output.

challenge.scenario: A local current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub') claim is described as a Supabase Auth-signed token and the release gate approves hosted SQL based on the Docker run.
challenge.finding: Trust boundary confused, managed JWT/session/Data API absent.
challenge.resolution: Provenance explicit LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_JWT_ROLE_TEST; JSON flags signedSupabaseJwtProven=false, hostedTouched=false, releaseAuthorized=false regardless of pass.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: F6-U03n source-pinned 78 original SQL and true Docker PG17 two-tenant Alap/Pro authenticated role RLS positive/negative proof passed at #38858690953. It did not execute anonymous office relation reads or directly invoke private security-definer thread and plan helpers with foreign instance/thread identifiers. The tenant model remains incomplete against those attack paths. Add an isolated original-schema role-only negative test with positive helper controls and deny foreign/unknown/Alap-internal identities, without mistaking GUC synthetic JWT for signed Supabase JWT.
observableOutcomes: Run unchanged original 78 historical Git-reviewed SQL through canonical F6-U03k true PostgreSQL17 bootstrap, preflight/postflight/COMMIT with exact local peer/PG17/DB/role selectors, and original F6-U03n schema/auth/tenant fixture.
Execute anonymous real office_threads, office_messages and office_tasks SELECT with zero rows, current_user anon, rolbypassrls=false and NULL auth.uid, independently from authenticated sessions.

Directly call exactly source-declared private.current_user_can_read_office_thread_v1(uuid,uuid), private.office_thread_plan_allowed_v2(uuid,uuid) and private.office_task_plan_allowed_v2(uuid,uuid) under authenticated synthetic A/B/user stranger claims.
Require legitimate same-tenant A customer and B customer/private true helper controls; require foreign instance/thread, unknown actor, and Alap internal_private false as negative controls.

Adversarial tests reject missing positive response, forged role, role bypass, anon rows, unknown function return or accidental cross-tenant truth; neither raw role output nor unit mock alone suffices.
Persist JSON exact-case evidence with LOCAL_PG17_ANON_FOREIGN_HELPER_DENIAL_NOT_SIGNED_JWT only, releaseAuthorized=false, managed provider Auth/Data API/Storage and real JWT remain blocked.
Get exact-head full CI Security/Quality/TS/build, Truth/Lifecycle and independent Docker PG17 proof; keep PR DRAFT and #1186/#1228 open.
unresolvedRisks: Local auth.uid is an explicit isolated claim emulator; it cannot verify signed Supabase JWT, expiration, Data API exposed-schema, revocation, storage or role security.
SECURITY DEFINER helper execution under local authenticated role proves only specified UUID combinations, not semantic safety for every input or full tenant domain.
The original role fixture seeds only 2 organizations and three users; real customer/support team identity matrix requires additional guarded evidence.
Private schema USAGE/EXECUTE grants in Docker may diverge from hosted managed-provider configuration; API schema routing separate.

Real native PG17 anon SELECT and per-case authenticated direct private Office helper boolean probes, explicit positive and cross-store negative counts.
